description: Structure and review an investor pitch deck with the "lensing" method from pitch designer Chris Laughlin. Use when outlining a fundraising deck, rewriting the opening slides, reviewing a deck before it goes to investors, planning when to start a raise, or preparing pitch delivery. Replaces the generic Problem / Solution template with a four-slide context opener built around how each investor partner already sees the world.
